title: Hot tip
text: A coworker swears a certain stock is about to skyrocket.

outcomes.text: It doubled! I cashed out at $4,000.
It crashed. My $2,000 is gone.
I passed. Probably smart.
The stock doubled in a month. I told myself it was luck and did not look at the chart again for a year.
The stock cratered. My coworker stopped bringing it up, and I never mentioned it either.

title: Crypto evangelist
text: {fr.first} won't stop talking about a new coin called "FrogCash".

outcomes.text: FrogCash went up 40x. I made $39,000.
FrogCash's founder vanished with everyone's money.
I nodded until {fr.first} changed the subject.
{fr.first} sent me a link to the coin every day for a week. I muted the thread.
A year later FrogCash was worth nothing. {fr.first} asked me not to bring it up. I didn't.

title: The will
text: Your {rel.rel} left behind a confusing will, and the family is fighting over it.

outcomes.text: I got $20,000 and a family feud.
The lawyers took a third. I won anyway and lost two cousins.
A handwritten note turned up in a drawer, changing the split. The family feud ended in tears.
Peace in the family is worth more.
A cousin later pressed a cheque into my hand without a word. We never spoke about it.
Nobody thanked me. I stayed quiet and wondered what I'd proved.

title: Audit
text: The tax office wants to audit your finances.

outcomes.text: Everything checked out.
The accountant found a mistake in my favour and I got a refund. I've since become loyal to accountants.
The audit found an old error. I paid the difference plus a penalty and sat through a long lecture.
I found a deduction I'd missed. Refund!
I owed $8,000 in back taxes.

title: Late rent
text: Your tenant {ten.first} says rent will be late because {ten.he} lost {ten.his} job.

outcomes.text: {ten.first} paid in full three months later with a thank-you card.
{ten.first} never paid.
{ten.first} moved out angry.
{ten.first} left the flat in a worse state than I'd found it. I spent the deposit on the repairs.
A neighbour offered to rent it the next week at a better rate. I felt awful and relieved.
Halfway through I changed my mind. {ten.first} stayed. They paid me back within two months.

title: Burst pipe
text: A pipe burst in one of your rental properties.

outcomes.text: Good as new.
The plumber found a second leak I hadn't noticed. The bill went up. The building now runs like new.
Insurance covered half of it after a long argument. I'd never have won without the paperwork.
It held... for now.
It burst again, worse.

title: Great tenant
text: Your tenant {ten.first} fixed the fence and planted a garden on {ten.his} own dime.

outcomes.text: {ten.first} was thrilled.
{ten.first} stayed fifteen years and refused every rent increase I offered. A rare thing.
{ten.first} tried to decline and I insisted. A week later they left a pie at my door.
{ten.first} smiled and kept gardening.
The garden became the talk of the building. The next tenant asked for the same.
{ten.first} moved out six months later for a job in another city. I think about that garden.

title: Appraisal show
text: A TV antiques show is filming in your town.

outcomes.text: The appraiser gasped. It's worth twice what I thought.
It's a clever fake. Worth almost nothing.
Worth exactly what I paid.
I watched it on TV instead.
My neighbour's ugly vase turned out to be worth $40,000. I can't stop thinking about mine.
I found out later they'd appraised my neighbour's vase at $8. I felt vindicated for no reason.

title: Island party
text: Everyone wants an invite to a party on your private island.

choices.label: Throw the party of the decade

outcomes.text: Celebrities, politicians, a live orchestra on the beach. Legendary.
A guest broke into the wine cellar and a helicopter was dented. The bill came to a quarter million.
A famous person proposed on the beach. It went viral. My island is now known as "the proposal island".
A quiet week with the people I love.
A cousin I'd never met turned out to be a brilliant cook. We became close.
The uninvited sent jealous texts all week. I didn't reply.

title: Office pool
text: The office lottery pool asks if you want in for $20.

outcomes.text: We won $4,000,000 split twelve ways. My share: $333,000!
We lost, obviously.
I skipped it.
I skipped it. They won. Nobody lets me forget it.

title: Too good to be true
text: Your new partner {pt.first} keeps asking how much money you have.

outcomes.text: {pt.first} left the same week. That answers that.
{pt.first} signed without blinking. We're good.
I chose to trust {pt.first}.
{pt.first} later confessed they'd asked because they were worried about their own debts. We paid them off together.
Two years later {pt.first} left with a lot of my money. I was told I had been too trusting.
